connector.name: Slack MCP Server by jtalk22
connector.registryDescription: Slack MCP without OAuth - 21 tools, session-based, local-first. Free OSS + hosted tier from $19/mo.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.revasserlabs.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package slack-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jtalk22 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
